title.english: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

description: Rikuo Nura appears to be an average middle school student. No one knows that he comes home every day to a house full of youkai, nor that he transforms into the all-powerful leader of these spirits at night. However, much to the disappointment of many, Rikuo is determined to live as normal a life as possible.

node.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (human); 175 cm (yokai)

Rikuo Nura is 3/4 human and 1/4 yokai.

He is the son of [Rihan](https://anilist.co/character/34223/Nura-Rihan) and [Wakana Nura](https://anilist.co/character/33723/Nura-Wakana) and grandson of [Nurarihyon](https://anilist.co/character/23307/Nurarihyon) and [Yohime](https://anilist.co/character/34074/Yohime). He is the third and current head of the Nura Clan.

Due to having yokai blood in his lineage, Rikuo has two forms: one in which he takes a human form, and another where his yokai blood takes over and he becomes a full yokai. The former is frequently called his "day" form, whereas the latter is called his "night" form, as originally he was only able to maintain it during darkness.

Rikuo was originally reluctant to accept his yokai blood and his role as the successor to the Nura Clan because he was teased at school for talking about yokai. As he ages, he realizes he has the ability to protect both humans and yokai because of his heritage, and acknowledges himself as the third leader of the Nura Clan.

Rikuo has officially exchanged sakazuki with [Zen](https://anilist.co/character/30740/Zen), [Kubinashi](https://anilist.co/character/16602/Kubinashi), [Tsurara](https://anilist.co/character/16599/Oikawa-Tsurara), [Jami](https://anilist.co/character/31468/Jami), [Kappa](https://anilist.co/character/19433/Kappa), [Kurotabou](https://anilist.co/character/19434/Kurotabou) and [Aotabo](https://anilist.co/character/19431/Aotabo).

__Height:__ 150 cm  
__Clan:__ Nura Clan, Tsurara Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  

Tsurara is Rikuo's trusted attendant. She follows him to school under a human guise known as Tsurara Oikawa. She is a Yuki Onna yokai. Around the Nura House, she sometimes acts as a cook who makes delicious but usually chilled or cold food.

She is fiercely loyal to Rikuo and will do anything for him. She gets visibly jealous when Rikuo mentions Kana and loves Rikuo deeply, though it is not clear if her love is romantic.

__Height:__ 152 cm
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol

Kana is [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo)'s childhood friend and neighbor. She is an easily frightened girl who doesn't like the idea of yokai, yet ironically she often becomes embroiled in yokai-related incidents. She is hinted to have some affection for Rikuo, as she becomes jealous when she sees him spending time with [Tsurara](https://anilist.co/character/16599/Oikawa-Tsurara), and undeniably falls for his "night" form after he rescues her. She often worries about Rikuo's mental health, and is rather keen at noticing when he is upset over something but trying to keep it hidden.

__Height:__ 143 cm
__Clan:__ Keikain House
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol

Yura is an onmyoji of the Keikain House who specializes in shikigami. She is able to maintain four at once, impressing both [Nurarihyon](https://anilist.co/character/23307/Nurarihyon) and fellow onmyoji. She was trained by [Akifusa](https://anilist.co/character/31433/Keikain-Akifusa), who raised her to see yokai as evil. She seeks to complete her training by defeating Nurarihyon and then inheriting leadership of the Keikain household. After spending time with [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo) and being exposed to his yokai form, she begins to see how yokai are similar to people in that they are not all good or evil. She is a frugal girl who doesn't mind eating food that has fallen on the floor and is glad her shikigami don't require food. Her stomach growls at inopportune moments, but she doesn't seem to mind.

__Height:__ 185 cm  
__Clan:__ Gyuki Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Gyuki is a high-ranked subordinate of the Nura Clan and one of its board members.  He is a careful and meticulous planner, and his plans always have the Nura Clan's best interests at heart. He is generally a quiet and calm person who listens to all the facts before passing judgment, and his opinion is regarded highly. Once he reaches a conclusion, he will see it through to the end.  Gyuki was once a human named Umewakamaru who was born into a house of nobles. He decided to search for his mother after his father's death and her disappearance. He was tricked by a yokai who claimed to know his mother, when in reality it had eaten her, and was eaten himself. However, through the power of his hatred and will, he was reborn as a yokai after his death, destroying the yokai that had killed his mother and himself in the process.

__Height:__ 168 cm  
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Kubinashi is a yokai of the Nura Clan whose head floats above his shoulders as he has no neck. He frequently takes care of laundry around the Nura mansion and fights using string.  When he was a human, he was a chivalrous thief akin to Robin Hood. He was eventually killed by yokai, and he became a yokai himself to exact revenge on other yokai. After being defeated by Rihan, he joined his Night Parade. He looked after Rikuo when he was a child, often teaching him cat's cradle.  He was friends with Kejoro before she became a yokai.

__Height:__ 220 cm  
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  

Aotabo is called "the degenerate priest who wears the iron blue robe" and is the physically strongest yōkai in the Nura household.  Long before joining the Nura Clan, Aotabo was a warrior monk who was arrested for having committed a severe transgression and who had killed a thousand warriors. On the verge of being executed, a holy man's words changed his ideals and he decided to live for the sake of others. The holy man told Aotabo that if he continued to kill people, he would become a monster, and the way to regain his humanity was to save one person for each of the sins he had committed.

__Height:__ 164 cm  
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Kejourou is a yokai who uses her hair to fight and most frequently handles kitchen duties around the Nura household.  The members of the Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol frequently mistake her to be Rikuo's older sister. 

While alive, her name was Kino and she was friends with Kubinashi. As a member of the Rihan's Night Parade, she traveled and fought with Kubinashi.

__Height:__ 135 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Kappa is a yokai of the Nura Clan whose domain is the fear of water. He is one of Rikuo's guardians. He loves cucumbers and fights extremely well near water.

__Height:__ 195 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Kurotabou is called "The Assassin and Destruction Monk" and is often seen with Aotabo, as the two are known as the assault officers of the Nura Clan.   Kurotabou was originally part of Rihan's Night Parade. Kurotabou looked after Rikuo when he was a child and often fell victim to his pranks.

__Height:__ 155 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  

One of Rikuo's friends and member of Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol. She is Saori's best friend.

__Height:__ 143 cm  

Nurarihyon is the Supreme Commander of the Nura Clan. He is Yohime's husband, Rihan's father and Rikuo's grandfather.  When he was younger, he defeated Hagoromo Gitsune with his Night Parade of a Hundred Demons granting him the title of Lord of Pandemonium.

__Height:__ 177 cm  
__Clan:__ Yakushi Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Zen is a poisonous bird youkai who specializes in making medicine; however, his species has a short life-span that causes him to become weaker as he ages. He and [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo) were childhood friends. After being betrayed and nearly killed, he was rescued by "Night" Rikuo. Due to this, he supports Rikuo unconditionally.

__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Clan:__ Gyuki Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Mezumaru is the Gyuki Clan's young head assistant. He can control humans with strings and has a feminine appearance while not wearing his horse skull. His personality, while straightforward and determined, is also slightly naive and ditzy.

__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Clan:__ Gyuki Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Gozumaru lives in Nura house as a candidate for the next leader of the Gyuki Clan. He is usually calm and composed, but will hit Mezumaru on the head if he irritates him.

__Height:__ 38 cm  
__Clan:__ Mount Takao Tengu Party, Nura Clan  

Karasu Tengu is Nurarihyon's adviser and messenger. He loyally follows the Nura Clan. He has two sons and one daughter who make up the Sanba Garasu.

__Height:__ 148 cm 

Ryouta Neko is the head of the Bakeneko Clan and leader of 1st street. He requested that Rikuo free 1st street from the Kyuuso Clan. He is a known gambler.

__Height:__ 225 cm  
__Clan:__ Kanto Great Ape Alliance  
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Former leader of Kanto Great Ape Alliance. Wears a miko suit and a noh mask. He was killed by Muchi.  Four hundred years ago, he was part of Nurarihyon's Hyakki Yako and was among the Nura Clan forces who joined the assault on Osaka Castle. There, he fought against Kidomaru. Their fight never reached a conclusion, as Hagoromo Gitsune's defeat, left her forces without a reason to continue battling. About three hundred years ago, Hihi was among the Nura Clan echelon whom Rihan would consult in times of crisis, such as when the Hyaku Monogatari Clan caused havoc.

__Height:__ 225 cm
__Weight:__ 108 kg
__Clan:__ Kanto Great Ape Alliance
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan

Hihi's son. He's one of the tallest youkai staying at the Nura house. He is strong enough to stop a charging Takarabune with the help of Reira freezing the ground.

__Height:__ 197 cm 
__Clan:__ Gagoze Alliance  
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

The head of the Gagoze Alliance. He kidnaps and eats children, but was killed by young "Night" Rikuo.

__Height:__ 27 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

A local shrine deity. He has the power to heal disease if someone offers a thousand crane origami to his shrine. 

Because of years of being neglected, he became small and weak. At one point, the only person who came to visit his shrine was Natsumi. Thanks to Kiyotsugu and his friends, he became strong enough to heal Natsumi from Sodemogi's curse.

__Height:__ 133 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

A local shrine deity who wears a Heian style kimono. She was almost cursed by Sodemogi but was saved by Kurotabou. She was originally a human 400 years ago, but she was targeted by Hagoromo Gitsune because of her power that made her tears into pearls. After being saved by the Nura Clan, she moved to Edo. Worshiped by the people, she became a deity. She became attached to Hitotsume Nyudo.

__Height:__ 40 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

One of the youkai who lives in the Nura house. His head is a natto and he consequently smells like natto. He often played with Rikuo when he was a child.

**Height:** 160cm (5'2")
**Affiliation:** Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  

Rikuo's classmate and Natsumi's best friend. She is a member of Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol.

__Height:__ 137 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  

Shima is Kiyotsugu's underling, who has been supporting him since they were children. He also attends same school as Rikuo and is in his class.   He is good at soccer and saved Kiyotsugu when he was about to be cursed by Sodemogi.  He has a crush on Tsurara.

__Height:__ 170 cm 
__Affiliations:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Investigation Squad  

Rich and influential amongst his class, Kiyotsugu used to tease Rikuo about youkai until he was saved by "night" Rikuo years ago. He now has an obsession with youkai, even to the point of wanting to be kidnapped.   He has a high opinion of Night Rikuo, calling him "my idol, the emperor of the night" and citing how Night Rikuo has often saved humans.   He autonomously declared the formation of the Kiyojuji Paranormal Investigation Squad consisting of Rikuo and his classmates and regularly organizes youkai-oriented excursions. He has a website called "Youkai Knowledge" and styles himself a youkai hunter.  A running gag in the series is how he always just manages to miss having youkai encounters.

Birthday: February 11 Height: 147 cm Weight: 48 kg Clan: Shikoku Hachijuuhakki Yakou (former), Kyoto Youkai (former), Hyaku Monogatari (current)  A youkai whose black feathers make whoever they touch goes temporarily blind. She faces Tsurara but is defeated. She later takes the Mao's Hammer from Tamazuki and returns it to Mitsume Yazura of the Nura Clan.

**Height:** 165 cm
**Clan:** Shikoku Hachijuuhakki Yakou

She is a youkai who can turn her hair into hooks. ~!She fought Kejourou but is killed by Tamazuki.!~

__Height:__ 155 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Rikuo's mother and Rihan's second wife. She is human and lives in the Nura house, though she herself is human, she seems to have no problem living in a home full of yokai.  Wakana first met Rihan when she was in high school. Her household had been haunted by an evil spirit for quite some time, and he managed to get rid of it. As a result, they became friendly and he started taking her along on his nightly yōkai rides. Wakana frequently noticed that Rihan rarely smiled and would even go so far as to pull his mouth into an impromptu grin in an attempt to get him to do so. On one of their outings, she told him that she will make certain to live longer than him in order to always look out for him.

__Height:__ 200 cm 
__Clan:__ One-Eyed Demon Clan 
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Leader of One-Eyed Demon Clan. He greatly opposes the idea of Rikuo as the Third Head of the Nura Clan. 400 years ago, he was really different, as he stated to Kokehime after being saved from Hagoromo Gitsune, "Even if her tears became pearls, the one that fits her best is her smile", speaks volume of how different he was in the past.

__Height:__ 182 cm
__Clan:__ Daruma Alliance 
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Mokugyo Daruma is the leader of the Daruma Alliance and one of Nurarihyon's advisers. He fought Shoukera 400 years ago. He appears to have no mouth but still can speak.

__Height:__ 153 cm
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Setsura is Tsurara's mother. She was part of Nurarihyon's Hyakki Yako and had an unrequited love for him. As a result, she came to dislike his wife Yohime. At the battle with Hagoromo Gitsune, she had a match with Ibaraki Doji 400 years ago.  ~!Later she fell in love with Rihan but never confessed her love for him because she knew how deeply he loved Yamabuki Otome. She instructed her daughter, Tsurara to "take the lips of the 3rd heir".!~

Height: 35 cm Weight: 3 kg Affiliations: 88 Demons of Shikoku  A youkai who kills other Land gods who can't fight back and turns their beliefs into his fear. Legend says that if you receive a tug on your sleeve and turn to see no one there, it is Sodemogi who will when curse you. He seems to enjoy devouring articles of clothing from others. He curses Natsumi eating away at her life force and as a result is killed by Kurotabou.  Source: Wikipedia

__Height:__ 148 cm
__Affiliations:__ Nura Clan, Kijo Clan

Asajigahara no Kijo is a member of the Nura Clan and the head of the Kijo Clan. Though they appear as an old woman and young girl, both share the same traits and can be considered two parts of a set. They enjoy mocking others.   (Source: Nurarihyon no Mago Wikia)

**Height:** 173 cm
**Clan:** Nura Clan, Mount Takao Tengu Party

Leader of the Sanba Garasu. Karasu Tengu's eldest son who has inherited his father's seriousness.

**Height:** 178 cm
**Clan:** Nura Clan, Mount Takao Tengu Party  

One of the Sanba Garasu and son of Karasu Tengu.

**Height:** 170 cm 
**Clan:** Nura Clan, Mount Takao Tengu Party  

One of the Sanba Garasu. The daughter of Karasu Tengu.

__Height:__ 123 cm
__Clan:__ Yakushi Clan 
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

A yokai who looks like a scaly humanoid with a snake's head who can elongate his neck or turn into a large snake.

__Height:__ 142 cm 
__Clan:__ Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako (88 Demons of Shikoku)  

He is a yokai found near riverbanks. He has zig-zag teeth which he use to eat fish and animals.   

(Source: Wikipedia)

__Clan:__ Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako 
__Affiliation:__ Nura Clan  

Leader of the 88 kiyakou of the four kingdoms, his father is the head of the Shikoku Hachijuukakki Yako, Tanuki. He is able to inspire his men through his charisma but sees them as disposable, he sees through Rikuo's power and seeks to return the world to darkness, even inviting Rikuo to join his group behind him in order to do so.  
~!He gained his power by killing his allies and brothers using the Mao's Hammer, the very sword that defeated his clan. He was defeated by Rikuo and spared on his father's wishes on the condition he never leave Shikoku and he holds a memorial for those he killed.!~ 

(Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 170 cm 

Inugami is a human turned Inugami who serves Tamazuki faithfully. He was bullied relentlessly by a group of humans led by Tamazuki and killed them after releasing his power. He hates and envies Rikuo for having both human and Yokai allies. He can transform into a large dog or separate his head from his body.
Height: 197 cm Weight: 83 kg Affiliations: 88 Demons of Shikoku  A yokai from Shikoku who manipulates the wind like a whip to cut enemies or make them fall ill.  (Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 180 cm

He is an anthropomorphic rat yokai who first appears as a light-haired playboy going by the name Seiya. He runs a host club near the east entrance of Ukiyoe Town's shopping district. He is a cruel and cold-hearted rat who takes advantage of people's weaknesses. He is able to summon regular-sized rats to do his bidding, and seems to hate rejection.  (Source: Nurarihyon no Mago wikia)

__Height:__ 157 cm

Professor Adashibara is a yokai researcher and novelist whom Kiyotsugu greatly admires. He is a middle-aged man with a seedy look to him, surrounded by an eerie atmosphere.

__Height:__ 255 cm 
__Clan:__ Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako (88 Demons of Shikoku)  

One of the seven heads of the Shikoku. An Oni  who is so large it's said he straddles the gaps between mountains. He is the strongest of the group but loses to Aotabo after he removes his necklace.

**Height:** 210 cm
**Affiliations:** Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako (88 Demons of Shikoku)  

One of the seven heads of the Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako, a bird yokai who breathes fire.

Height: 273 cm Weight: 210 kg  Also known as "the purple mirror". A yokai that resembles a huge flaming skull attached to a tiny lion-like body. It rides a bicycle and is able to travel via mirrors, trapping its victims in the same manner. If you look into its mirror, you will be killed on your thirteenth birthday.   ~!Kana first encountered it when she was 6 years old, when she and some other children found and looked into a purple mirror. The rest of the children turned up missing (and eventually dead) after they started middle school. It reappears on Kana's thirteenth birthday with the intent to kill her but is stopped by "Night" Rikuo.!~  (Source: Wikipedia)

Birthday: January 17 Height: 563 cm Weight: 897 kg Affilations: Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako ( (88 Demons of Shikoku))  Tamazuki's father and the leader of the Shikoku area yokai. He formed the original Shikoku yokai 300 years ago. When his forces stormed Matsuyama Castle, he refused help from Nurarihyon because he knew it would result in him becoming part of the latter's Hyakki Yako.  (Source: Wikipedia)
One of Yura's shikigami. He is an ancestor of the Keikain clan.
Umewakamaru's mother.
Umewakamaru's father.

Sannokuchi is a small youkai of the Nura Clan. Because his mouth looks like the number "3", he is named as such. He is often seen in the company of Natto Kozo, Tofu Kozo and Ko Oni, and the group frequently play Go or hold miniature banquets.

The Errand Rat Yōkai (使いネズミ, Tsukai nezumi) is a small anthropomorphic rat yōkai who wears a kimono. He is a member of the Kyūso Clan who witnessed Kana and Yura being kidnapped and informed Rikuo of it.
